subject: Implement syscall handling (host FS)
description: Handle the syscall instruction: read $v0 for number, $a0-$a3/$t0-$t1 for args. Implement read(0),write(1),open(2),close(3),lseek(8),fsync(74),rename(82),mkdir(83),unlink(87) mapping to real host filesystem via Node fs. Translate MIPS buffer addresses.
